repositories.decision_reason: Source and tests show a reusable mechanism for representing long-running agent workflows as typed graph state plus checkpoint metadata, parent checkpoint links, pending writes, durability modes, task streams, and interrupt/error recovery. Open issue evidence around streamed-state persistence and checkpoint serialization means adoption should be gated by crash, cancellation, and serializer tests.
repositories.revisit_reason: Review production checkpointer behavior, streamed-state cancellation persistence, serializer customization, and any post-0.6 changes to durable interrupt semantics.
repositories.next_revisit_condition: Revisit after a material change to checkpoint storage, interrupt handling, serializer behavior, cancellation semantics, or managed runtime semantics.

repositories.decision_reason: Graphiti has source evidence for episode-anchored entity/fact extraction, edge deduplication, temporal invalidation, and hybrid retrieval.
